text_block_list.text:
It's really pouring today. I guess I won't
be able to
use the track.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Sigh... So foggy... I can't even see any of the scenery outside...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Maybe Spe and I should make sunshine
dolls to
wish for good weather.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука appears to be down in
the dumps
since she can't go on her
daily jog.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
